objective: Seek restricted project funding for an MIT-licensed offline source-to-claim provenance verifier without presenting a grant application as customer revenue.

program.name: Hacker Initiative 2026 Grant Cycle: Signal/Noise
limits: One application per project per cycle
The application must be submitted through the English online form
An application may advance to a remote presentation
Awarded funding may be less than requested
Recipients owe project and budget reports
The applicant is responsible for lawful USD receipt and tax compliance

project.name: Proofline: Offline Source-to-Claim Verification
fit: Runs offline and does not upload source files
Checks local SHA-256 hashes for source and derived artifacts
Checks transformation references and source-located evidence for verified claims
Keeps unverified and rejected claims distinct from verified claims
Produces a deterministic non-zero exit on broken evidence
project.claim_boundary: A passing manifest establishes internal evidence-chain consistency only; it does not prove source truth, rights, authorship, learning outcomes, customer results, or security certification.

budget.item: Four diverse offline test kits, removable storage, and capture peripherals
Fixed-scope independent security, privacy, and accessibility reviews
budget.gate: Confirm that external fixed-scope review expense is allowable before submission

budget.item: Small tester stipends and accessibility reimbursements
Shipping, adapters, media, and test consumables

excluded_costs: Books, films, videos, social media, or website production
Advertising, merchandise, fundraising, or general awareness work
private_fields_required: Responsible payee and physical mailing address
Alternate contact details and responsible parties
application.submission_gate: Review the exact entity, tax recipient, budget, eligibility, allowability, contact fields, and agreements in the visible form before submitting.

funnel.policy: Restricted project funding remains separate from customer revenue. An application, invitation, award notice, pending check, or click is not received money.
